::: {.hero-section}
## Welcome to the MLSecOps Lab

We are a group of four graduate students from the University of Washington, Information Management Class of 2026, and this lab is designed to guide you through the core concepts and practical applications of MLOps.

This lab is developed in collaboration with **Boeing**, working closely with Jared, Uzma, and Geetha, and supported by the **Women in Cloud (WIC)** team.

Our goal is to provide a hands-on, structured learning experience that bridges academic foundations with real-world MLOps practices used in industry.
:::

---

Explore the topics below to build your MLOps expertise from foundations to production deployment.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### {{< fa rocket >}} Need for MLOps

Understand why production ML systems need more than just accurate models — and why the gap between a notebook and a production service is wider than it looks.

[Get started →](MLOps.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}
:::
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### {{< fa toolbox >}} Resources

Essential resources for Python and Git — the two tools you'll use throughout every part of this lab.

[Python Resources →](Python.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}
[Git Resources →](git_resources.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-sm}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### {{< fa server >}} Infra Setup

Provision and connect your cloud infrastructure: push code from GitHub to Azure, define resources with Terraform, build your ML pipeline, and ingest data.

[Git to Azure →](vc.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}
:::
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### {{< fa brain >}} ML Foundations

Learn the fundamentals: understand and process the NYC Taxi dataset, train supervised and unsupervised models, register them in the Model Registry, and create a real-time endpoint.

[Understanding Dataset →](dataset.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}
:::
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### {{< fa chart-simple >}} Monitoring

Keep your ML system healthy after deployment. Detect data drift and model drift, set up alerts, and close the loop back to retraining when performance degrades.

[Start monitoring →](monitoring_maintainance.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}
:::
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
::: {.card-body}
### {{< fa shield-halved >}} Security & Best Practices

Learn RBAC, secrets management, reproducible pipelines, and production-grade safeguards to keep your MLOps stack secure and auditable.

[Learn more →](security_best_practices.qmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}
:::
:::
:::

---

::: {.callout-note}
## About This Lab
This lab uses the NYC Taxi dataset as a real-world example throughout all modules. You'll learn how to build, deploy, monitor, and maintain ML systems that predict trip duration and fare amounts — just like production systems at scale.
:::
